Explain and practise: git 4th

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
git status

git checkout -b GitWork

echo "<xml></xml>" >> hello.xml

git add hello.xml

git status

git commit -m "1st"

git push -u origin GitWork

git checkout master

echo "<title></title>" >> hello.xml

git add hello.xml

git commit -m "1st in master"

git push

git log oneline --graph --decorate --all

git diff --name-status master GitWork

git merge GitWork

git mergetool

git commit -m "done"

git status

echo "*~" >> .gitignore

git commit -m "backup"

git branch 

git branch -d GitWork

git log --oneline --graph --decorate
